Transparency about monetization

Advertising Disclosure

How NovelNest will identify advertising, sponsored material, affiliate relationships, and the separation between ads and editorial content.

Advertising may support NovelNest

NovelNest may use advertising in the future to help pay for hosting, maintenance, development, and the time required to organize and improve the reading experience.

Ads do not control ordinary editorial guides

Normal Reading Desk articles are intended to be selected and written for reader usefulness. Advertising placement or payment should not determine the conclusions of those articles.

Sponsored content

If NovelNest publishes paid or sponsored content, it should be clearly labeled so readers can distinguish it from ordinary editorial work.

Affiliate links

If affiliate links are ever used, NovelNest will disclose that a purchase made through those links may generate a commission. There are currently no affiliate claims on this page.

Ad technology and privacy

If Google AdSense or another advertising provider is enabled, the Privacy Policy will describe the relevant use of cookies, device identifiers, consent tools, and advertising partners. NovelNest should not use a fake publisher ID or pretend that an ad service is active before it is actually configured.
